summary: Broadridge Financial Solutions filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a registered offering of senior notes due 2036. The offering size, interest rate, and final maturity date are left blank, indicating it is preliminary. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated, and not listed on any exchange, with no subsidiary guarantees. There is a change-of-control repurchase provision at 101% of principal. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is involved.
